title: The Grand Old Duke of York
transcription:
The Grand Old Duke
of York
Action song

The grand old Duke of York
He had ten thousand men
He marched them up a hill
Then he marched them down again.

And when you're up you're up
And when you're down you're down
And when you're only half-way up
You're neither up nor down.
notes: Draft song-level split from visual page transcription. Source page note: Draft visual transcription; small action symbols omitted and some italic instructions may need verification.
